        const rawKhuList: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = Array.isArray(
          payload.khuTroList
        )
          ? payload.khuTroList
          : Array.isArray(payload.danhSachCoSo)
          ? payload.danhSachCoSo
          : Array.isArray(payload.khuTro)
          ? payload.khuTro
          : [];

        const rawTinList: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = Array.isArray(
          payload.tinDangList
        )
          ? payload.tinDangList
          : [];

        // Trích xuất thông tin Chủ trọ từ Database
        const rawChuTro =
          (payload.chuTro as Record<string, unknown>) ||
          (payload.chuTroInfo as Record<string, unknown>) ||
          rawKhuList.find((k) => k.TenChuTro || k.SDTChuTro) ||
          rawTinList.find((t) => t.TenChuTro || t.SDTChuTro) ||
          null;

        const chuTro = rawChuTro
          ? {
              hoTen: String(
                rawChuTro.hoTen ||
                  rawChuTro.TenChuTro ||
                  rawChuTro.HoTen ||
                  'Chủ trọ'
              ).trim(),
              sdt: String(
                rawChuTro.sdt ||
                  rawChuTro.SDTChuTro ||
                  rawChuTro.SDT ||
                  'Đang cập nhật'
              ).trim(),
            }
          : null;

        // Trích xuất danh sách Quản lý theo từng Cơ sở (KhuTro) từ Database
        const danhSachCoSo = rawKhuList.map((khu, idx) => {
          const maKhu = (khu.MaKhu ?? khu.maKhu ?? idx + 1) as number | string;
          const matchingTin = rawTinList.find(
            (t) => Number(t.MaKhu) === Number(maKhu)
          );

          const tenKhu = String(
            khu.TenKhu || khu.tenKhu || `Cơ sở ${idx + 1}`
          ).trim();

          const tenQuanLy = String(
            khu.TenQuanLy ||
              khu.tenQuanLy ||
              khu.HoTen ||
              matchingTin?.TenQuanLy ||
              `Quản lý ${tenKhu}`
          ).trim();

          const sdtQuanLy = String(
            khu.SDTQuanLy ||
              khu.sdtQuanLy ||
              khu.SDT ||
              khu.SoDienThoai ||
              matchingTin?.SDTQuanLy ||
              matchingTin?.SDT ||
              'Đang cập nhật'
          ).trim();

          return {
            maKhu,
            tenKhu,
            tenQuanLy,
            sdtQuanLy,
          };
        });

        if (isMounted) {
          setSupportData({ chuTro, danhSachCoSo });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Lỗi khi tải thông tin liên hệ hỗ trợ:', err);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setLoadingSupport(false);
        }
      }
    };

    fetchSupportContacts();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setInfoPanel(null);

    const cleanTenTK = tenTK.trim();
    if (!cleanTenTK || !matKhau) {
      showError('Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ tài khoản và mật khẩu!');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const response = await AuthService.login({
        TenTK: cleanTenTK,
        MatKhau: matKhau,
      });

      const user = response.data?.user;
      if (!user) {
        showError('Không lấy được thông tin tài khoản!');
        return;
      }

      // Xử lý lưu hoặc xóa ghi nhớ mật khẩu 30 ngày (Mã hóa AES-GCM)
      if (rememberMe) {
        await saveRememberedCredentials(cleanTenTK, matKhau);
      } else {
        clearRememberedCredentials();
      }

      const targetUrl =
        user.Quyen === 'ChuTro' || user.Quyen === 'QuanLy'
          ? '/chuTro/thongKe'
          : '/nguoiThue/thongKe';

      showSuccess(
        `Xin chào ${user.HoTen}, đang chuyển vào hệ thống...`,
        'Đăng nhập thành công!',
        1.5,
        () => {
          router.replace(targetUrl);
        }
      );
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        showError(error.message, 'Đăng nhập thất bại!', 2.5);
      } else {
        showError('Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ, vui lòng thử lại!');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[960px]">
      <div className="w-full bg-white text-slate-900 rounded-[28px] p-6 sm:p-10 md:p-12 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 md:gap-12">
        {/* CỘT TRÁI: Logo từ /img/logo.png + Tiêu đề lớn */}
        <div className="md:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-[#00FFCC]/20 border border-[#00FFCC] p-1.5 flex items-center justify-center mb-6 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
              <img
                src="/img/logo.png"
                alt="Logo Xóm Trọ"
                className="w-full h-full object-contain"
              />
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
              Đăng nhập
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-3 text-base text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
              Sử dụng Tài khoản{' '}
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-[#00FFCC]/30 text-slate-900 font-bold">
                Xóm Trọ
              </span>{' '}
              của bạn để tiếp tục tới Hệ thống Quản lý Nhà trọ & IoT
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Hộp thông tin Liên hệ hỗ trợ (Lấy trực tiếp từ Database) */}
          <div className="mt-6">
            {infoPanel === 'support' && (
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#00FFCC]/15 border border-[#00FFCC] text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm mb-1">
                  <span>Hỗ trợ trực tuyến</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setInfoPanel(null)}
                    className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                </div>

                {loadingSupport ? (
                  <p className="text-slate-500 italic">
                    Đang tải thông tin liên hệ từ hệ thống...
                  </p>
                ) : supportData.chuTro || supportData.danhSachCoSo.length > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    {supportData.chuTro && (
                      <p>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          Chủ trọ ({supportData.chuTro.hoTen}):
                        </strong>{' '}
                        {supportData.chuTro.sdt}
                      </p>
                    )}

                    {supportData.danhSachCoSo.map((cs) => (
                      <p key={cs.maKhu}>
                        <strong className="text-slate-900">
                          - {`Quản lý ${cs.tenKhu}`}{' '}
                        </strong>{' '}
                        <p>({cs.tenQuanLy}): {cs.sdtQuanLy}</p>
                      </p>
                      
                    ))}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-slate-500">
                    Chưa có thông tin liên hệ trong cơ sở dữ liệu.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CỘT PHẢI: Form nhập liệu */}
        <div className="md:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-center">
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-5" autoComplete="off">
            <div>
              <label
                htmlFor="tenTK"
                className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 ml-1"
              >

              </label>
              <input
                id="tenTK"
                type="text"
                value={tenTK}
                onChange={(e) => setTenTK(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Nhập tài khoản của bạn"

              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label
                htmlFor="matKhau"
                className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 ml-1"
              >

              </label>

              {/* Ô nhập mật khẩu kèm nút Icon Con Mắt bên trong */}
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  id="matKhau"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}

                  onChange={(e) => setMatKhau(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Nhập mật khẩu"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="w-full pl-4 pr-11 py-3.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-base text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00FFCC] transition [&::-ms-reveal]:hidden [&::-ms-clear]:hidden"

                <button

                  title={showPassword ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Hiện mật khẩu'}
                  className="absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <EyeIcon visible={showPassword} />

              {/* Hàng tùy chọn: Ghi nhớ mật khẩu + Quên mật khẩu */}
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-700 cursor-pointer select-none">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={rememberMe}
                    onChange={(e) => setRememberMe(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-teal-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                  <span>Ghi nhớ mật khẩu</span>
                </label>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => router.push('/taiKhoan/quenMatKhau')}

              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Cụm nút dưới đáy */}
            <div className="pt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <button
                type="button"

                }

              >

              <button

                className="px-7 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#00FFCC] hover:bg-[#00e6b8] disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-900 font-bold text-xs shadow-sm border border-teal-300 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Đang xử lý...' : 'Đăng nhập'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Thanh chân Card */}
      <div className="mt-4 px-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 gap-2">
        <Link
          href="/"
          className="text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 font-semibold transition no-underline"

        <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
          <button

          >

          </button>
          <span>Bảo mật</span>
          <span>Điều khoản</span>
        </div>
      </div>

  );
}

// client/src/components/hoaDon/PhatSinhRowsEditor.tsx
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import CurrencyInput from '@/components/common/CurrencyInput';
import { FormError, inputErrorClass } from '@/utils/formValidation';

export interface PhatSinhDraftItem {
  TenPS: string;
  Gia: string;
  GhiChu: string;
}

export function validatePhatSinhRow(
  ps: PhatSinhDraftItem,
  showValidation: boolean
) {
  const ten = ps.TenPS.trim();
  const giaStr = String(ps.Gia ?? '').trim();
  const giaNum = Number(giaStr);
  const ghiChu = ps.GhiChu || '';

  const isStarted = ten !== '' || giaStr !== '' || ghiChu.trim() !== '';

  let tenError: string | null = null;
  let giaError: string | null = null;
  let ghiChuError: string | null = null;

  if (showValidation || isStarted) {
    if (!ten) {
      tenError = 'Vui lòng nhập tên khoản phát sinh.';
    } else if (ten.length > 100) {
      tenError = 'Tên khoản phát sinh tối đa 100 ký tự.';
    }

    if (giaStr === '' || Number.isNaN(giaNum) || giaNum < 1000) {
      giaError = 'Số tiền phát sinh phải từ 1.000 VNĐ trở lên.';
    }
  }

  if (ghiChu.length > 255) {
    ghiChuError = 'Ghi chú không vượt quá 255 ký tự.';
  }

  return {
    tenError,
    giaError,
    ghiChuError,
    hasError: Boolean(tenError || giaError || ghiChuError),
  };
}

interface PhatSinhRowsEditorProps {
  items: PhatSinhDraftItem[];
  showValidation?: boolean;
  showLabels?: boolean;
  onChange: (
    index: number,
    field: keyof PhatSinhDraftItem,
    value: string
  ) => void;
  onRemove: (index: number) => void;
}

export default function PhatSinhRowsEditor({
  items,
  showValidation = false,
  showLabels = false,
  onChange,
  onRemove,
}: PhatSinhRowsEditorProps) {
  if (items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {items.map((ps, idx) => {
        const { tenError, giaError, ghiChuError } = validatePhatSinhRow(
          ps,
          showValidation
        );

        return (
          <div
            key={idx}
            className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-12 gap-2.5 items-start bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200"
          >
            {/* 1. Tên khoản phát sinh */}
            <div className="sm:col-span-4">
              {showLabels && (
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">
                  Tên khoản phát sinh <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
              )}
              <input
                type="text"
                value={ps.TenPS}
                onChange={(e) => onChange(idx, 'TenPS', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Tên khoản phát sinh (VD: Sửa bóng đèn...)"
                className={`w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold focus:outline-none transition ${inputErrorClass(
                  tenError
                )}`}
              />
              <FormError message={tenError} />
            </div>

            {/* 2. Số tiền phát sinh */}
            <div className="sm:col-span-3">
              {showLabels && (
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">
                  Số tiền (VNĐ) <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
              )}
              <CurrencyInput
                value={ps.Gia}
                onChange={(val) => onChange(idx, 'Gia', val)}
                placeholder="VD: 50.000"
                suffix="VNĐ"
                className={
                  giaError
                    ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50/30 focus:ring-red-300'
                    : ''
                }
              />
              <FormError message={giaError} />
            </div>

            {/* 3. Ghi chú */}
            <div className="sm:col-span-4">
              {showLabels && (
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">
                  Ghi chú
                </label>
              )}
              <input
                type="text"
                value={ps.GhiChu}
                onChange={(e) => onChange(idx, 'GhiChu', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ghi chú chi tiết..."
                className={`w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold focus:outline-none transition ${inputErrorClass(
                  ghiChuError
                )}`}
              />
              <FormError message={ghiChuError} />
            </div>

            {/* 4. Nút Bỏ */}
            <div
              className={`sm:col-span-1 text-right ${
                showLabels ? 'sm:pt-5' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onRemove(idx)}
                className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer transition"
              >
                Bỏ
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/home/AiChatbotWidget.tsx
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { GiaDienNuocHome } from "@/services/home.service";
import { aiChatService, SharedChatState } from "@/services/aiChat.service";
import {
  TinDangItem,
  KhuTroWithContact,
  formatVND,
} from "./home.data";

interface AiChatbotWidgetProps {
  isOpen?: boolean;
  onToggleOpen?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  tinDangList: TinDangItem[];
  khuTroList: KhuTroWithContact[];
  giaDienNuoc?: GiaDienNuocHome | null;
  onSelectContactRoom?: (room: TinDangItem) => void;
}

export default function AiChatbotWidget({
  isOpen: externalIsOpen,
  onToggleOpen,
  onClose,
  tinDangList,
  khuTroList,
}: AiChatbotWidgetProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState<string>("");
  const [questionPage, setQuestionPage] = useState<number>(0);

  // Đồng bộ với kho trạng thái xuyên trang (giữ nguyên đoạn chat khi chuyển trang)
  const [chatState, setChatState] = useState<SharedChatState>(() =>
    aiChatService.getState()
  );

  const chatEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const questionScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setChatState({ ...aiChatService.getState() });
    const unsubscribe = aiChatService.subscribe(() => {
      setChatState({ ...aiChatService.getState() });
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  // Nếu từ nút "Nhờ AI tư vấn chọn phòng" ở HeroSection truyền isOpen=true xuống thì đồng bộ mở luôn
  useEffect(() => {
    if (externalIsOpen === true && !chatState.isOpen) {
      aiChatService.setOpen(true);
    }
  }, [externalIsOpen, chatState.isOpen]);

  const isChatVisible = chatState.isOpen;
  const isAiTyping = chatState.isTyping;
  const chatMessages = chatState.messages;
  const aiDynamicQuestions = chatState.dynamicQuestions;

  const handleToggleChat = () => {
    const nextOpen = !isChatVisible;
    aiChatService.setOpen(nextOpen);
    if (nextOpen && onToggleOpen && !externalIsOpen) {
      onToggleOpen();
    } else if (!nextOpen && onClose) {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  const handleCloseChat = () => {
    aiChatService.setOpen(false);
    if (onClose) onClose();
  };

  // Ngân hàng câu hỏi động dựa trên dữ liệu thực tế
  const questionPool = useMemo(() => {
    const pool: string[] = [
      "Hiện có những phòng nào đang trống?",
      "Các tiện ích đi kèm trong phòng gồm những gì?",
      "Bảng phí dịch vụ (Wifi, rác, giữ xe) tính thế nào?",
      "Đơn giá điện nước IoT tính như thế nào?",
      "Phòng nào hiện có Máy lạnh và Gác lửng?",
    ];

    if (tinDangList.length > 0) {
      const firstRoom = tinDangList[0];
      pool.push(`Phòng ${firstRoom.TenPhong} có những tiện ích gì?`);

      const minPrice = Math.min(...tinDangList.map((t) => Number(t.Gia) || 0));
      if (minPrice > 0) {
        pool.push(`Tìm phòng trống giá khoảng ${formatVND(minPrice)}?`);
      }

      if (tinDangList.length >= 2) {
        pool.push(
          `So sánh phòng ${tinDangList[0].TenPhong} và ${tinDangList[1].TenPhong}?`
        );
      }
    }

    if (khuTroList.length > 0) {
      const firstKhu = khuTroList[0];
      pool.push(`Ở ${firstKhu.TenKhu} hiện còn phòng trống không?`);
    }

    pool.push("Thông tin liên hệ Quản lý cơ sở và Chủ trọ?");
    return Array.from(new Set(pool));
  }, [tinDangList, khuTroList]);

  const displayedQuestions = useMemo(() => {
    if (aiDynamicQuestions.length > 0) {
      return aiDynamicQuestions;
    }
    const pageSize = 4;
    const total = questionPool.length;
    if (total <= pageSize) return questionPool;

    const start = (questionPage * 2) % total;
    const items: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < pageSize; i++) {
      items.push(questionPool[(start + i) % total]);
    }
    return items;
  }, [aiDynamicQuestions, questionPool, questionPage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isChatVisible) {
      chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  }, [chatMessages, isChatVisible, isAiTyping]);

  // Chuyển sang trang chi tiết tin đăng mà VẪN GIỮ NGUYÊN lịch sử & khung chat
  const handleViewRoomDetail = (roomFromAi: TinDangItem) => {
    const matchedInHome = tinDangList.find(
      (t) =>
        Number(t.MaPhong) === Number(roomFromAi.MaPhong) ||
        Number(t.MaTin) === Number(roomFromAi.MaTin)
    );

    const maTin = matchedInHome?.MaTin || roomFromAi.MaTin;
    if (maTin) {
      aiChatService.setOpen(true);
      router.push(`/tinDang/${maTin}`);
    } else {
      document
        .getElementById("tin-dang")
        ?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  };

  const handleRefreshQuestions = () => {
    aiChatService.clearDynamicQuestions();
    setQuestionPage((prev) => prev + 1);
    questionScrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handleSendAiMessage = async (customQuestion?: string) => {
    const content = (customQuestion ?? chatInput).trim();
    if (!content || isAiTyping) return;

    if (!customQuestion) {
      setChatInput("");
    }
    await aiChatService.askQuestion(content);
    questionScrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-40 flex flex-col items-end pointer-events-none">
      {isChatVisible && (
        <div className="pointer-events-auto mb-3 w-85 sm:w-96 bg-white border-2 border-[#00FFCC] rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
          {/* Header Chatbox */}
          <div className="bg-[#00FFCC] text-slate-900 px-5 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-teal-300">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-white text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                AI
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                    Trợ Lý Ảo AI Nhà Trọ
                  </h3>
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 animate-pulse" />
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Tư vấn phòng trống, tiện ích & phí dịch vụ 24/7
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCloseChat}
              className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white/80 hover:bg-white text-slate-800 border border-teal-300 text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Thu gọn hộp thoại"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Danh sách tin nhắn */}
          <div className="p-4 h-84 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-50/70 space-y-3">
            {chatMessages.map((msg) => (
              <div
                key={msg.id}
                className={`flex flex-col ${
                  msg.sender === "user" ? "items-end" : "items-start"
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`max-w-[88%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line ${
                    msg.sender === "user"
                      ? "bg-[#00FFCC] text-slate-900 font-semibold border border-teal-300 rounded-br-xs shadow-2xs"
                      : "bg-white text-slate-800 border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs rounded-bl-xs"
                  }`}
                >
                  {msg.text}

                  {/* Nút mở Trang chi tiết tin đăng của phòng */}
                  {msg.sender === "ai" &&
                    msg.suggestedRooms &&
                    msg.suggestedRooms.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-col gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-700">
                          Phòng trống gợi ý (Bấm để xem chi tiết tin đăng):
                        </span>
                        {msg.suggestedRooms.map((room) => (
                          <button
                            key={`${msg.id}-room-${room.MaPhong}`}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleViewRoomDetail(room)}
                            className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-[#00FFCC]/25 hover:bg-[#00FFCC]/50 text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 transition flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer group"
                          >
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-900 truncate">
                                Xem chi tiết phòng {room.TenPhong}
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-600 truncate">
                                {room.TenKhu} • {formatVND(room.Gia)}/tháng (
                                {room.DienTich}m²)
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#00FFCC] group-hover:bg-[#00e6b8] text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 text-[10px] font-bold shrink-0 transition">
                              Xem tin đăng →
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1 px-1">
                  {msg.time}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}

            {/* Chỉ hiển thị 1 dòng ngắn gọn khi AI đang tìm câu trả lời */}
            {isAiTyping && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-white border border-teal-200 w-fit max-w-full shadow-2xs">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-teal-500 animate-ping shrink-0" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 truncate">
                  Đang tìm câu trả lời...
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div ref={chatEndRef} />
          </div>

          {/* Thanh câu hỏi gợi ý động */}
          <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-white border-t border-slate-100 space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-0.5">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                Gợi ý câu hỏi nhanh:
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isAiTyping}
                onClick={handleRefreshQuestions}
                className="text-[10px] font-bold text-teal-700 hover:text-teal-900 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                title="Đổi bộ câu hỏi gợi ý khác"
              >
                <span>↻ Đổi câu hỏi khác</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div
              ref={questionScrollRef}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-thin"
            >
              {displayedQuestions.map((q) => (
                <button
                  key={q}
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isAiTyping}
                  onClick={() => handleSendAiMessage(q)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-[#00FFCC]/25 hover:bg-[#00FFCC] disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 whitespace-nowrap transition cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  {q}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Ô nhập câu hỏi */}
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              handleSendAiMessage();
            }}
            className="p-3 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <input
              type="text"
              value={chatInput}
              onChange={(e) => setChatInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Hỏi phòng trống, tiện ích, phí dịch vụ..."
              className="flex-1 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-400 text-slate-900"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={!chatInput.trim() || isAiTyping}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-[#00FFCC] hover:bg-[#00e6b8] disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              Gửi
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Nút mở/đóng AI Chatbot */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleToggleChat}
        className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#00FFCC] hover:bg-[#00e6b8] text-slate-900 shadow border border-green-500 shrink-0 transition cursor-pointer"
      >
        <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xs">
          AI
        </span>
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
          {isChatVisible ? "Đóng Trợ lý AI" : "Chat tư vấn AI"}
        </span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/home/ChiTietTinDangClient.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, SyntheticEvent } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

import HomeHeader from "@/components/layout/homeHeader";
import AppFooter from "@/components/layout/AppFooter";
import ContactRoomModal from "@/components/home/ContactRoomModal";
import AiChatbotWidget from "@/components/home/AiChatbotWidget";
import { useAlertModal } from "@/components/common/AlertModalProvider";
import BangGiaSection from "@/components/home/BangGiaSection";

import {
  HomeService,
  TinDangHome,
  TienIchItem,
  GiaDienNuocHome,
  PhiDichVuItem,
  isAvailablePublicTinDang,
} from "@/services/home.service";
import {
  resolveRoomImageUrl,
  DEFAULT_ROOM_FALLBACK_IMAGE,
} from "@/services/phongTro.service";
import {
  KhuTroWithContact,
  TinDangItem,
  extractManagerContact,
  formatVND,
  formatDateVN,
} from "./home.data";
import {
  extractRoomImageList,
  RoomImageObject,
} from "./TinDangSection";

interface ChiTietTinDangClientProps {
  maTin: number;
}

const DEFAULT_GIA_DIEN_NUOC: GiaDienNuocHome = {
  MaGia: 1,
  GiaDien: 3500,
  GiaNuoc: 15000,
  NgayApDung: "2026-01-01",
};

export default function ChiTietTinDangClient({
  maTin,
}: ChiTietTinDangClientProps) {
  const { showSuccess } = useAlertModal();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTin, setCurrentTin] = useState<TinDangHome | null>(null);
  const [allTinDang, setAllTinDang] = useState<TinDangHome[]>([]);
  const [khuTroList, setKhuTroList] = useState<KhuTroWithContact[]>([]);
  const [systemTienIch, setSystemTienIch] = useState<TienIchItem[]>([]);
  const [giaDienNuoc, setGiaDienNuoc] = useState<GiaDienNuocHome>(
    DEFAULT_GIA_DIEN_NUOC
  );
    const [phiDichVuList, setPhiDichVuList] =
    useState<PhiDichVuItem[]>([]);
  const [activeImageUrl, setActiveImageUrl] = useState<string>("");
  const [relatedFilter, setRelatedFilter] = useState<"ALL" | "SAME_KHU">("ALL");
  const [contactRoom, setContactRoom] = useState<TinDangItem | null>(null);
  const [isChatOpen, setIsChatOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleImageError = (e: SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement, Event>) => {
    const target = e.currentTarget;
    if (target.src !== DEFAULT_ROOM_FALLBACK_IMAGE) {
      target.onerror = null;
      target.src = DEFAULT_ROOM_FALLBACK_IMAGE;
    }
  };

  const handleCopyPhone = (phone: string, tenNguoiLienHe: string) => {
    if (!phone) return;
    if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(phone);
    }
    showSuccess(
      `Đã sao chép số điện thoại ${phone} của ${tenNguoiLienHe}!`,
      "Sao chép thành công",
      2
    );
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    async function fetchDetailAndRelated() {
      if (!maTin || isNaN(maTin)) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const homePayload = await HomeService.getHomeData();
        if (!isMounted) return;

        const validList = (homePayload.tinDang || []).filter((t) =>
          isAvailablePublicTinDang(t)
        );
        setAllTinDang(validList);
        setKhuTroList((homePayload.khuTro || []) as KhuTroWithContact[]);
        setSystemTienIch(homePayload.tienIch || []);
        if (homePayload.giaDienNuoc) {
          setGiaDienNuoc(homePayload.giaDienNuoc);
        }

        setPhiDichVuList(homePayload.phiDichVu || []);

        const matchedTin =
          validList.find((t) => Number(t.MaTin) === Number(maTin)) || null;

        setCurrentTin(matchedTin);

        if (matchedTin) {
          const imgs = extractRoomImageList(
            matchedTin as unknown as TinDangItem
          );
          const firstPath = imgs.length > 0 ? imgs[0].DuongDan : null;
          setActiveImageUrl(resolveRoomImageUrl(firstPath));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Lỗi khi tải trang chi tiết tin đăng:", err);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchDetailAndRelated();
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [maTin]);

  const detailImageList = useMemo<RoomImageObject[]>(() => {
    if (!currentTin) return [];
    return extractRoomImageList(currentTin as unknown as TinDangItem);
  }, [currentTin]);

  const detailContact = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentTin) return null;
    return extractManagerContact(
      currentTin as unknown as TinDangItem,
      khuTroList
    );
  }, [currentTin, khuTroList]);

  const detailDiaChi = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentTin) return "";
    if (currentTin.DiaChi) return String(currentTin.DiaChi);
    const foundKhu = khuTroList.find(
      (k) => Number(k.MaKhu) === Number(currentTin.MaKhu)
    );
    return foundKhu?.DiaChi || "Đang cập nhật địa chỉ";
  }, [currentTin, khuTroList]);

  const detailTienIchList = useMemo<TienIchItem[]>(() => {
    if (!currentTin) return [];
    const anyTin = currentTin as any;
    if (Array.isArray(anyTin.TienIch) && anyTin.TienIch.length > 0) {
      return anyTin.TienIch;
    }
    if (
      Array.isArray(currentTin.DanhSachTienIch) &&
      currentTin.DanhSachTienIch.length > 0
    ) {
      return currentTin.DanhSachTienIch;
    }
    return systemTienIch;
  }, [currentTin, systemTienIch]);

  const otherTinDangList = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentTin) return allTinDang;

    const others = allTinDang.filter(
      (item) => Number(item.MaTin) !== Number(currentTin.MaTin)
    );

    others.sort((a, b) => {
      const aSameKhu = Number(a.MaKhu) === Number(currentTin.MaKhu) ? 1 : 0;
      const bSameKhu = Number(b.MaKhu) === Number(currentTin.MaKhu) ? 1 : 0;
      return bSameKhu - aSameKhu;
    });

    if (relatedFilter === "SAME_KHU") {
      return others.filter(
        (item) => Number(item.MaKhu) === Number(currentTin.MaKhu)
      );
    }

    return others;
  }, [allTinDang, currentTin, relatedFilter]);

  const sameKhuCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentTin) return 0;
    return allTinDang.filter(
      (item) =>
        Number(item.MaTin) !== Number(currentTin.MaTin) &&
        Number(item.MaKhu) === Number(currentTin.MaKhu)
    ).length;
  }, [allTinDang, currentTin]);

  const formattedNgayDang = useMemo(() => {
    return formatDateVN(currentTin?.NgayDang).formattedDate;
  }, [currentTin]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50 text-slate-900">

        {...({
          khuTroCount: khuTroList.length,
          phongTrongCount: allTinDang.length,
        } as any)}
      />

      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 sm:py-10 space-y-12">
        <nav
          aria-label="Breadcrumb"
          className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs"
        >
          <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 list-none m-0 p-0">
            <li>
              <Link href="/" className="hover:text-teal-700 transition">
                Trang chủ
              </Link>
            </li>
            <li>/</li>
            <li>
              <Link href="/#tin-dang" className="hover:text-teal-700 transition">
                Danh sách phòng mở thuê
              </Link>
            </li>
            {currentTin && (
              <>
                <li>/</li>
                <li className="text-slate-900 font-bold truncate max-w-xs sm:max-w-md">
                  Phòng {currentTin.TenPhong} ({currentTin.TenKhu})
                </li>
              </>
            )}
          </ol>

          <Link
            href="/"
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-[#00FFCC] text-slate-900 transition"
          >
            ← Quay lại trang chủ
          </Link>
        </nav>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xs animate-pulse grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">
            <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
              <div className="w-full h-80 sm:h-96 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl" />
              <div className="h-36 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl" />
            </div>
            <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-5">
              <div className="h-28 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl" />
              <div className="h-48 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl" />
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : !currentTin || !detailContact ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-10 text-center max-w-xl mx-auto shadow-xs space-y-4">
            <span className="inline-block px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#00FFCC] text-slate-900">
              Tin đăng không khả dụng
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">
              Không tìm thấy thông tin phòng trọ này hoặc phòng đã được thuê
            </h1>
            <Link
              href="/#tin-dang"
              className="inline-block px-5 py-2.5 bg-[#00FFCC] hover:bg-[#00e6b8] text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition"
            >
              Xem toàn bộ phòng trống tại trang chủ
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <article className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 sm:px-8 py-4 bg-[#00FFCC] text-slate-900 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">

                <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-slate-900 text-[#00FFCC]">

                    <div className="absolute top-3 left-3">

                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
                          {Number(tin.DienTich)} m²

                      <h4 className="mt-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 line-clamp-2">
                        <Link href={itemHref} className="hover:text-teal-700">
                          {tin.TieuDe}
                        </Link>
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    <footer className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Link
                        href={itemHref}
                        className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800"
                      >
                        Xem chi tiết
                      </Link>
                      {contact.hasPhoneFromDB && (
                        <a
                          href={contact.zaloUrl}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noopener noreferrer"
                          className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-white text-[#0068FF] border border-[#0068FF]"
                        >
                          Zalo
                        </a>
                      )}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setContactRoom(tin as unknown as TinDangItem)
                        }
                        className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-[#00FFCC] hover:bg-[#00e6b8] text-slate-900 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Liên hệ thuê
                      </button>
                    </footer>
                  </div>
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <ContactRoomModal
        contactRoom={contactRoom}
        khuTroList={khuTroList}
        onClose={() => setContactRoom(null)}
        onCopyPhone={handleCopyPhone}
      />

      <AiChatbotWidget
        isOpen={isChatOpen}
        onToggleOpen={() => setIsChatOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        onClose={() => setIsChatOpen(false)}
        tinDangList={allTinDang as unknown as TinDangItem[]}
        khuTroList={khuTroList}
        giaDienNuoc={giaDienNuoc}
        onSelectContactRoom={(room) => setContactRoom(room)}
      />

      <AppFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/home/ContactRoomModal.tsx
"use client";

import {
  TinDangItem,
  KhuTroWithContact,
  extractManagerContact,
  extractOwnerContact,
  formatVND,
} from "./home.data";

interface ContactRoomModalProps {
  contactRoom: TinDangItem | null;
  khuTroList: KhuTroWithContact[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onCopyPhone: (phone: string, tenQuanLy: string) => void;
}

export default function ContactRoomModal({
  contactRoom,
  khuTroList,
  onClose,
  onCopyPhone,
}: ContactRoomModalProps) {
  if (!contactRoom) return null;

  const selectedRoomContact = extractManagerContact(contactRoom, khuTroList);
  const ownerContact = extractOwnerContact(contactRoom, khuTroList);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs p-4">
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        {/* Header Modal */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3.5">
          <div>
            <span className="inline-block px-3 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-[#00FFCC] text-slate-900 mb-1">
              {contactRoom.TenKhu}
            </span>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
              Liên Hệ Thuê Phòng {contactRoom.TenPhong}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Khối 1: Giá thuê & Quản lý cơ sở */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Giá thuê:</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-teal-700">
              {formatVND(contactRoom.Gia)} / tháng ({contactRoom.DienTich} m²)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Người quản lý:</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">
              {selectedRoomContact.tenQuanLy}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
              Số điện thoại / Zalo:
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 bg-[#00FFCC]/40 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
              {selectedRoomContact.hasPhoneFromDB
                ? selectedRoomContact.sdtHienThi
                : "Chưa cập nhật trong CSDL"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {selectedRoomContact.hasPhoneFromDB ? (
          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            {/* Nút Zalo chuẩn tông màu xanh Zalo (#0068FF) */}
            <a
              href={selectedRoomContact.zaloUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#0068FF] hover:bg-[#0052CC] text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm shadow-[#0068FF]/25 transition no-underline"
            >
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white text-[#0068FF] text-[10px] font-bold leading-none">
                Zalo
              </span>
              <span>
                Nhắn tin qua Zalo ({selectedRoomContact.sdtHienThi})
              </span>
            </a>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
              <a
                href={selectedRoomContact.telUrl}
                className="py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#00FFCC] hover:bg-[#00e6b8] text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition no-underline"
              >
                <span>📞 Gọi điện ngay</span>
              </a>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  onCopyPhone(
                    selectedRoomContact.cleanPhone,
                    selectedRoomContact.tenQuanLy
                  )
                }
                className="py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>📋 Sao chép SĐT</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-xs text-amber-800">
            Số điện thoại của người quản lý khu trọ này chưa được cập nhật trên
            cơ sở dữ liệu.
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Khối 2: Thông tin liên hệ Chủ trọ (Bắt buộc có mặt cho mọi cơ sở) */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#00FFCC]/15 border border-teal-300 space-y-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-600 font-medium">
              Chủ trọ:
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">
              {ownerContact.tenChuTro}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-600 font-medium">
              SĐT / Zalo Chủ trọ:
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 bg-white border border-teal-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
              {ownerContact.hasPhoneFromDB
                ? ownerContact.sdtHienThi
                : "Đang cập nhật"}
            </span>
          </div>

          {ownerContact.hasPhoneFromDB && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-1">
              <a
                href={ownerContact.zaloUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="py-2 px-2 rounded-xl bg-[#0068FF] hover:bg-[#0052CC] text-white font-bold text-[11px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-2xs transition no-underline"
              >
                <span className="px-1 py-0.5 rounded bg-white text-[#0068FF] text-[9px] font-bold leading-none">
                  Zalo
                </span>
                <span>Chủ trọ</span>
              </a>
              <a
                href={ownerContact.telUrl}
                className="py-2 px-2 rounded-xl bg-[#00FFCC] hover:bg-[#00e6b8] text-slate-900 border border-teal-300 font-bold text-[11px] flex items-center justify-center transition no-underline"
              >
                📞 Gọi Chủ trọ
              </a>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  onCopyPhone(
                    ownerContact.cleanPhone,
                    `Chủ trọ ${ownerContact.tenChuTro}`
                  )
                }
                className="py-2 px-2 rounded-xl bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 font-bold text-[11px] flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                📋 Chép SĐT
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/home/home.data.ts
import { KhuTroSummary } from "@/services/home.service";

const RAW_ENV_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:5000/api";
const API_ROOT = RAW_ENV_URL.replace(/\/auth\/?$/, "").replace(/\/$/, "");

export const PUBLIC_TIN_DANG_URL = API_ROOT.endsWith("/api")
  ? `${API_ROOT}/tin-dang/public`
  : `${API_ROOT}/api/tin-dang/public`;

export type TrangThaiTin = "DangHienThi" | "DaAn" | "HetHan";

export interface TinDangItem {
  MaTin: number;
  MaPhong: number;
  MaND: number;
  TieuDe: string;
  MoTa: string | null;
  NgayDang: string;
  NgayHetHan: string | null;
  TrangThai: TrangThaiTin;
  TenPhong: string;
  DienTich: number;
  Gia: number;
  TrangThaiPhong: string;
  MaKhu: number;
  TenKhu: string;
  DiaChiKhu?: string | null;
  DanhSachTienIch?: string | null;
  AnhDaiDien?: string | null;
  TenChuTro?: string | null;
  TenQuanLy?: string | null;
  HoTen?: string | null;
  SDTChuTro?: string | null;
  SDTQuanLy?: string | null;
  SDT?: string | null;
  SoDienThoai?: string | null;
}

export type KhuTroWithContact = KhuTroSummary & {
  TenQuanLy?: string | null;
  TenChuTro?: string | null;
  HoTen?: string | null;
  SDTQuanLy?: string | null;
  SDTChuTro?: string | null;
  SDT?: string | null;
  SoDienThoai?: string | null;
};

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  sender: "ai" | "user";
  text: string;
  time: string;
  suggestedRooms?: TinDangItem[];
}

export interface ManagerContactInfo {
  tenQuanLy: string;
  sdtHienThi: string;
  cleanPhone: string;
  hasPhoneFromDB: boolean;
  zaloUrl: string;
  telUrl: string;
}

export interface OwnerContactInfo {
  tenChuTro: string;
  sdtHienThi: string;
  cleanPhone: string;
  hasPhoneFromDB: boolean;
  zaloUrl: string;
  telUrl: string;
}

export const GOI_Y_CAU_HOI_AI = [
  "Hiện có những phòng nào đang trống?",
  "Đơn giá điện nước tính như thế nào?",
  "Cách liên hệ Zalo quản lý khu trọ?",
];

// Định dạng tiền tệ cố định không dùng Intl để tránh lỗi Hydration #418 (args[]=text)
export const formatVND = (amount: number | string) => {
  const numeric = Math.round(Number(amount) || 0);
  return numeric.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".") + " đ";
};

// Định dạng ngày DD/MM/YYYY cố định theo GMT+7 không dùng Intl để Server (UTC) và Client khớp 100%
export const formatDateVN = (
  dateInput?: string | Date | null
): {
  formattedDate: string;
  isoDate?: string;
} => {
  if (!dateInput) return { formattedDate: "Mới cập nhật" };

  const rawStr = typeof dateInput === "string" ? dateInput.trim() : "";
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(rawStr)) {
    const [y, m, d] = rawStr.split("-");
    return {
      formattedDate: `${d}/${m}/${y}`,
      isoDate: `${rawStr}T00:00:00.000Z`,
    };
  }

  const date = new Date(dateInput);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return { formattedDate: "Mới cập nhật" };

  const vnTime = new Date(date.getTime() + 7 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const dd = String(vnTime.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const mm = String(vnTime.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const yyyy = vnTime.getUTCFullYear();

  return {
    formattedDate: `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy}`,
    isoDate: date.toISOString(),
  };
};

export const extractManagerContact = (
  tin: TinDangItem,
  khuTroList: KhuTroWithContact[]
): ManagerContactInfo => {
  const khu = khuTroList.find((k) => Number(k.MaKhu) === Number(tin.MaKhu));

  const tenQuanLy =
    tin.TenQuanLy ||
    khu?.TenQuanLy ||
    tin.HoTen ||
    khu?.HoTen ||
    tin.TenChuTro ||
    khu?.TenChuTro ||
    `Quản lý ${tin.TenKhu}`;

  const rawPhone =
    tin.SDTQuanLy ||
    khu?.SDTQuanLy ||
    tin.SDT ||
    tin.SoDienThoai ||
    khu?.SDT ||
    khu?.SoDienThoai ||
    tin.SDTChuTro ||
    khu?.SDTChuTro ||
    "";

  const cleanPhone = String(rawPhone).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");

  return {
    tenQuanLy,
    sdtHienThi: String(rawPhone).trim(),
    cleanPhone,
    hasPhoneFromDB: cleanPhone.length > 0,
    zaloUrl: cleanPhone ? `https://zalo.me/${cleanPhone}` : "#",
    telUrl: cleanPhone ? `tel:${cleanPhone}` : "#",
  };
};

export const extractOwnerContact = (
  tin: TinDangItem,
  khuTroList: KhuTroWithContact[]
): OwnerContactInfo => {
  const khu = khuTroList.find((k) => Number(k.MaKhu) === Number(tin.MaKhu));
  const anyKhuWithOwner = khuTroList.find(
    (k) => k.TenChuTro || k.SDTChuTro
  );

  const tenChuTro =
    tin.TenChuTro?.trim() ||
    khu?.TenChuTro?.trim() ||
    anyKhuWithOwner?.TenChuTro?.trim() ||
    "Nguyễn Thị Quỳnh Dư";

  const rawPhone =
    tin.SDTChuTro?.trim() ||
    khu?.SDTChuTro?.trim() ||
    anyKhuWithOwner?.SDTChuTro?.trim() ||
    "";

  const cleanPhone = String(rawPhone).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");

  return {
    tenChuTro,
    sdtHienThi: String(rawPhone).trim(),
    cleanPhone,
    hasPhoneFromDB: cleanPhone.length > 0,
    zaloUrl: cleanPhone ? `https://zalo.me/${cleanPhone}` : "#",
    telUrl: cleanPhone ? `tel:${cleanPhone}` : "#",
  };
};

// src/components/home/HomePageClient.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import HomeHeader from "@/components/layout/homeHeader";
import { useAlertModal } from "@/components/common/AlertModalProvider";
import {
  HomeService,
  TienIchItem,
  PhiDichVuItem,
  GiaDienNuocHome,
} from "@/services/home.service";

import {
  PUBLIC_TIN_DANG_URL,
  TinDangItem,
  KhuTroWithContact,
} from "@/components/home/home.data";
import HeroSection from "@/components/home/HeroSection";
import TinDangSection from "@/components/home/TinDangSection";
import KhuTroSection from "@/components/home/KhuTroSection";
import BangGiaSection from "@/components/home/BangGiaSection";
import ContactRoomModal from "@/components/home/ContactRoomModal";
import AiChatbotWidget from "@/components/home/AiChatbotWidget";
import Appfooter from "@/components/layout/AppFooter";

export interface HomePageClientProps {
  initialTinDangList: TinDangItem[];
  initialTienIchList: TienIchItem[];
  initialPhiDichVuList: PhiDichVuItem[];
  initialKhuTroList: KhuTroWithContact[];
  initialGiaDienNuoc: GiaDienNuocHome;
  hasServerData: boolean;
}

export default function HomePageClient({
  initialTinDangList,
  initialTienIchList,
  initialPhiDichVuList,
  initialKhuTroList,
  initialGiaDienNuoc,
  hasServerData,
}: HomePageClientProps) {
  const { showSuccess } = useAlertModal();

  // Khởi tạo State ngay từ dữ liệu Server để HTML trả về có sẵn danh sách phòng cho Googlebot
  const [tinDangList, setTinDangList] =
    useState<TinDangItem[]>(initialTinDangList);
  const [tienIchList, setTienIchList] =
    useState<TienIchItem[]>(initialTienIchList);
  const [phiDichVuList, setPhiDichVuList] =
    useState<PhiDichVuItem[]>(initialPhiDichVuList);
  const [khuTroList, setKhuTroList] =
    useState<KhuTroWithContact[]>(initialKhuTroList);
  const [giaDienNuoc, setGiaDienNuoc] =
    useState<GiaDienNuocHome>(initialGiaDienNuoc);

  // Nếu Server đã lấy được dữ liệu thì loading = false ngay từ đầu (rất quan trọng cho SEO)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(!hasServerData);

  // State bộ lọc đa tiêu chí
  const [selectedKhu, setSelectedKhu] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [selectedMucGia, setSelectedMucGia] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [selectedDienTich, setSelectedDienTich] = useState<string>("ALL");

  // State điều khiển Modal liên hệ & Hộp thoại AI
  const [contactRoom, setContactRoom] = useState<TinDangItem | null>(null);
  const [isChatOpen, setIsChatOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Hàm tải dữ liệu dự phòng ở Client (chỉ kích hoạt nếu SSR bị lỗi kết nối nội bộ)
  const fetchHomeAndTinDang = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const [tinDangResponse, homeData] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(PUBLIC_TIN_DANG_URL, {
          method: "GET",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          cache: "no-store",
        }).catch(() => null),
        HomeService.getHomeData().catch(() => null),
      ]);

      let loadedFromPublicRoute = false;

      if (tinDangResponse && tinDangResponse.ok) {
        const result = await tinDangResponse.json().catch(() => null);
        const rawList =
          result?.data?.tinDangList ||
          (Array.isArray(result?.data) ? result.data : null);

        if (result?.success && Array.isArray(rawList)) {
          const danhSachCongKhai = (rawList as TinDangItem[]).filter(
            (tin) => !tin.TrangThai || tin.TrangThai === "DangHienThi",
          );
          setTinDangList(danhSachCongKhai);
          loadedFromPublicRoute = true;
        }
      }

      if (!loadedFromPublicRoute && homeData?.tinDang) {
        setTinDangList(homeData.tinDang as unknown as TinDangItem[]);
      }

      if (homeData) {
        setTienIchList(homeData.tienIch || []);
        setPhiDichVuList(homeData.phiDichVu || []);
        setKhuTroList((homeData.khuTro as KhuTroWithContact[]) || []);
        if (homeData.giaDienNuoc) {
          setGiaDienNuoc(homeData.giaDienNuoc);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Lỗi khi tải dữ liệu trang chủ & tin đăng:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Chỉ fetch lại dưới Client nếu Server chưa nạp được dữ liệu
    if (!hasServerData) {
      fetchHomeAndTinDang();
    }
  }, [hasServerData, fetchHomeAndTinDang]);

  // Lọc danh sách tin đăng theo đa tiêu chí
  const filteredTinDangList = useMemo(() => {
    return tinDangList.filter((tin) => {
      if (selectedKhu !== "ALL" && String(tin.MaKhu) !== selectedKhu) {
        return false;
      }

      const gia = Number(tin.Gia) || 0;
      if (selectedMucGia === "DUOI_25" && gia >= 2500000) return false;
      if (
        selectedMucGia === "TU_25_DEN_40" &&
        (gia < 2500000 || gia > 4000000)
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (selectedMucGia === "TREN_40" && gia <= 4000000) return false;

      const dienTich = Number(tin.DienTich) || 0;
      if (selectedDienTich === "DUOI_20" && dienTich >= 20) return false;
      if (
        selectedDienTich === "TU_20_DEN_30" &&
        (dienTich < 20 || dienTich > 30)
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (selectedDienTich === "TREN_30" && dienTich <= 30) return false;

      return true;
    });
  }, [tinDangList, selectedKhu, selectedMucGia, selectedDienTich]);

  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setSelectedKhu("ALL");
    setSelectedMucGia("ALL");
    setSelectedDienTich("ALL");
  };

  const scrollToSection = (id: string) => {
    document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handleCopyPhone = (phone: string, tenQuanLy: string) => {
    if (!phone) return;
    if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(phone);
    }
    showSuccess(
      `Đã sao chép số điện thoại ${phone} của ${tenQuanLy}!`,
      "Sao chép thành công",
      2,
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50 text-slate-900">
      <HomeHeader />

      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12 space-y-12">
        <HeroSection
          soKhuTro={khuTroList.length}
          soPhongMo={tinDangList.length}
          giaDienNuoc={giaDienNuoc}
          onScrollToSection={scrollToSection}
          onOpenChat={() => setIsChatOpen(true)}
        />

        <TinDangSection
          tinDangList={tinDangList}
          filteredTinDangList={filteredTinDangList}
          khuTroList={khuTroList}
          tienIchList={tienIchList}
          loading={loading}
          selectedKhu={selectedKhu}
          selectedMucGia={selectedMucGia}
          selectedDienTich={selectedDienTich}
          onChangeKhu={setSelectedKhu}
          onChangeMucGia={setSelectedMucGia}
          onChangeDienTich={setSelectedDienTich}
          onResetFilters={handleResetFilters}
          onSelectContactRoom={setContactRoom}
        />

        <KhuTroSection
          khuTroList={khuTroList}
          onSelectKhuAndScroll={(maKhu) => {
            setSelectedKhu(maKhu);
            scrollToSection("tin-dang");
          }}
        />

        <BangGiaSection
          giaDienNuoc={giaDienNuoc}
          phiDichVuList={phiDichVuList}
        />
      </main>

      <ContactRoomModal
        contactRoom={contactRoom}
        khuTroList={khuTroList}
        onClose={() => setContactRoom(null)}
        onCopyPhone={handleCopyPhone}
      />

      <AiChatbotWidget
        isOpen={isChatOpen}
        onToggleOpen={() => setIsChatOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        onClose={() => setIsChatOpen(false)}
        onSelectContactRoom={(room) => setContactRoom(room)}
        tinDangList={tinDangList}
        khuTroList={khuTroList}
        giaDienNuoc={giaDienNuoc}
      />
       <Appfooter />
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/home/TinDangSection.tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, SyntheticEvent } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  resolveRoomImageUrl,
  DEFAULT_ROOM_FALLBACK_IMAGE,
} from "@/services/phongTro.service";
import { TienIchItem } from "@/services/home.service";
import {
  TinDangItem,
  KhuTroWithContact,
  extractManagerContact,
  formatVND,
  formatDateVN,
} from "./home.data";

export interface RoomImageObject {
  MaAnh: number;
  DuongDan: string;
  AnhChinh: number;
}

interface TinDangSectionProps {
  tinDangList: TinDangItem[];
  filteredTinDangList: TinDangItem[];
  khuTroList: KhuTroWithContact[];
  tienIchList: TienIchItem[];
  loading: boolean;
  selectedKhu: string;
  selectedMucGia: string;
  selectedDienTich: string;
  onChangeKhu: (val: string) => void;
  onChangeMucGia: (val: string) => void;
  onChangeDienTich: (val: string) => void;
  onResetFilters: () => void;
  onSelectContactRoom: (tin: TinDangItem) => void;
}

// Kiểm tra tin đăng đang hiển thị và còn hạn để hiển thị đầy đủ trên trang chủ
function isPublicTinDangActive(tin: TinDangItem): boolean {
  if (!tin) return false;
  const anyTin = tin as any;
  const rawStatus = String(anyTin.TrangThai || "DangHienThi")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

  // Loại bỏ tin Đã ẩn hoặc Hết hạn
  if (
    [
      "daan",
      "da an",
      "đã ẩn",
      "an",
      "ẩn",
      "hethan",
      "het han",
      "hết hạn",
      "dahethan",
      "đã hết hạn",
    ].includes(rawStatus)
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  // Kiểm tra ngày hết hạn nếu có
  if (anyTin.NgayHetHan) {
    const expiry = new Date(anyTin.NgayHetHan);
    if (!Number.isNaN(expiry.getTime())) {
      expiry.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
      if (expiry.getTime() < Date.now()) {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }

  return true;
}

export function extractRoomImageList(tin: TinDangItem): RoomImageObject[] {
  const anyTin = tin as any;
  const rawList: RoomImageObject[] = [];

  const sourceArray = Array.isArray(anyTin.DanhSachAnh)
    ? anyTin.DanhSachAnh
    : Array.isArray(anyTin.AnhPhongList)
      ? anyTin.AnhPhongList
      : [];

  sourceArray.forEach((item: any, idx: number) => {
    if (
      item &&
      typeof item === "object" &&
      typeof item.DuongDan === "string" &&
      item.DuongDan.trim()
    ) {
      rawList.push({
        MaAnh: Number(item.MaAnh) || idx + 1,
        DuongDan: item.DuongDan.trim(),
        AnhChinh: Number(item.AnhChinh) === 1 ? 1 : 0,
      });
    } else if (typeof item === "string" && item.trim()) {
      rawList.push({
        MaAnh: idx + 1,
        DuongDan: item.trim(),
        AnhChinh: idx === 0 ? 1 : 0,
      });
    }
  });

  if (
    rawList.length === 0 &&
    typeof tin.AnhDaiDien === "string" &&
    tin.AnhDaiDien.trim()
  ) {
    rawList.push({
      MaAnh: 1,
      DuongDan: tin.AnhDaiDien.trim(),
      AnhChinh: 1,
    });
  }

  const seenUrls = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueList: RoomImageObject[] = [];

  for (const img of rawList) {
    const resolved = resolveRoomImageUrl(img.DuongDan);
    if (!seenUrls.has(resolved)) {
      seenUrls.add(resolved);
      uniqueList.push(img);
    }
  }

  uniqueList.sort((a, b) => Number(b.AnhChinh) - Number(a.AnhChinh));

  return uniqueList;
}

export default function TinDangSection({
  tinDangList,
  filteredTinDangList,
  khuTroList,
  tienIchList,
  loading,
  selectedKhu,
  selectedMucGia,
  selectedDienTich,
  onChangeKhu,
  onChangeMucGia,
  onChangeDienTich,
  onResetFilters,
  onSelectContactRoom,
}: TinDangSectionProps) {
  const handleImageError = (e: SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement, Event>) => {
    const target = e.currentTarget;
    if (target.src !== DEFAULT_ROOM_FALLBACK_IMAGE) {
      target.onerror = null;
      target.src = DEFAULT_ROOM_FALLBACK_IMAGE;
    }
  };

  const validTotalTinDangList = useMemo(() => {
    return tinDangList.filter((tin) => isPublicTinDangActive(tin));
  }, [tinDangList]);

  const validFilteredTinDangList = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredTinDangList.filter((tin) => isPublicTinDangActive(tin));
  }, [filteredTinDangList]);

  const jsonLdSchema = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "ItemList",
      name: "Danh Sách Phòng Trọ Đang Mở Cho Thuê",
      description:
        "Danh sách phòng trọ đang trống, cập nhật giá thuê, diện tích và thông tin liên hệ quản lý trực tiếp.",
      numberOfItems: validFilteredTinDangList.length,
      itemListElement: validFilteredTinDangList.map((tin, index) => {
        const roomImageObjs = extractRoomImageList(tin);
        const roomImages =
          roomImageObjs.length > 0
            ? roomImageObjs.map((img) => resolveRoomImageUrl(img.DuongDan))
            : [DEFAULT_ROOM_FALLBACK_IMAGE];

        return {
          "@type": "ListItem",
          position: index + 1,
          item: {
            "@type": "Accommodation",
            "@id": `/tinDang/${tin.MaTin}`,
            url: `/tinDang/${tin.MaTin}`,
            name: `${tin.TieuDe} - Phòng ${tin.TenPhong} (${tin.TenKhu})`,
            description:
              tin.MoTa ||
              `Cho thuê phòng ${tin.TenPhong} tại ${tin.TenKhu}, diện tích ${Number(tin.DienTich)}m².`,
            image: roomImages,
            floorSize: {
              "@type": "QuantitativeValue",
              value: Number(tin.DienTich),
              unitCode: "MTK",
            },
            offers: {
              "@type": "Offer",
              price: Number(tin.Gia),
              priceCurrency: "VND",
              availability: "https://schema.org/InStock",
            },
          },
        };
      }),
    };
  }, [validFilteredTinDangList]);

  return (
    <section
      id="tin-dang"
      aria-labelledby="tin-dang-heading"
      className="space-y-6"
    >
      {!loading && validFilteredTinDangList.length > 0 && (
        <script
          type="application/ld+json"
          suppressHydrationWarning
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLdSchema) }}
        />
      )}

      <header className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <span className="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-[#00FFCC]/30 text-slate-900 mb-1.5">
            Tra cứu phòng trống
          </span>
          <h2
            id="tin-dang-heading"
            className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900"
          >
            Danh Sách Phòng Đang Cần Cho Thuê ({validFilteredTinDangList.length}/
            {validTotalTinDangList.length})
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Hỗ trợ bộ lọc đa tiêu chí theo cơ sở, diện tích, mức giá thuê và xem
            chi tiết của từng phòng
          </p>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Bộ lọc đa tiêu chí */}
      <form
        role="search"
        aria-label="Bộ lọc tìm kiếm phòng trọ"
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xs space-y-4"
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3.5">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label
              htmlFor="filter-khu-tro"
              className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500"
            >
              Cơ sở / Khu trọ
            </label>
            <select
              id="filter-khu-tro"
              name="khu"
              value={selectedKhu}
              onChange={(e) => onChangeKhu(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500 text-slate-900"
            >
              <option value="ALL">Tất cả cơ sở ({khuTroList.length})</option>
              {khuTroList.map((khu) => (
                <option key={khu.MaKhu} value={String(khu.MaKhu)}>
                  {khu.TenKhu}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label
              htmlFor="filter-muc-gia"
              className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500"
            >
              Mức giá thuê / tháng
            </label>
            <select
              id="filter-muc-gia"
              name="gia"
              value={selectedMucGia}
              onChange={(e) => onChangeMucGia(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500 text-slate-900"
            >
              <option value="ALL">Tất cả mức giá</option>
              <option value="DUOI_25">Dưới 2.500.000 đ</option>
              <option value="TU_25_DEN_40">Từ 2.500.000 đ - 4.000.000 đ</option>
              <option value="TREN_40">Trên 4.000.000 đ</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label
              htmlFor="filter-dien-tich"
              className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500"
            >

            </label>
            <select
              id="filter-dien-tich"
              name="dientich"
              value={selectedDienTich}
              onChange={(e) => onChangeDienTich(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500 text-slate-900"
            >
              <option value="ALL">Tất cả diện tích</option>
              <option value="DUOI_20">Dưới 20 m²</option>
              <option value="TU_20_DEN_30">Từ 20 m² - 30 m²</option>
              <option value="TREN_30">Trên 30 m²</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 mr-1">
              Tiện ích tiêu chuẩn tại hệ thống:
            </span>
            <ul className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 list-none m-0 p-0">
              {tienIchList.length > 0 ? (
                tienIchList.slice(0, 6).map((ti) => (
                  <li
                    key={ti.MaTI}
                    className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"
                  >
                    {ti.TenTI}
                  </li>
                ))
              ) : (
                <>
                  <li className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700">

                  </li>
                  <li className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700">

                  </li>
                  <li className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700">
                    Kiểm soát vân tay / RFID
                  </li>

              )}
            </ul>
          </div>

          {(selectedKhu !== "ALL" ||
            selectedMucGia !== "ALL" ||
            selectedDienTich !== "ALL") && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onResetFilters}
              className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-[#00FFCC] text-slate-900 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              Đặt lại bộ lọc
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>

      {/* Lưới danh sách tin đăng */}
      {loading ? (
        <div
          aria-busy="true"
          aria-label="Đang tải danh sách phòng trọ"
          className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6"
        >
          {[1, 2, 3].map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item}
              className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-5 h-80 animate-pulse flex flex-col justify-between"
            >
              <div className="h-10 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl" />
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="h-5 bg-slate-100 rounded w-2/3" />
                <div className="h-4 bg-slate-100 rounded w-1/2" />

              <div className="h-9 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl" />

      ) : validFilteredTinDangList.length === 0 ? (

            const imageUrl = resolveRoomImageUrl(firstImgPath);
            const detailHref = `/tinDang/${tin.MaTin}`;

                  </span>
